questions.q: Which predefined General Ledger job role focuses on reporting and analysis rather than day-to-day transaction entry?
questions.explain: Financial Analyst is the predefined GL job role oriented toward reporting and analysis, distinct from General Accountant's transactional focus.

questions.q: In the Payables job role hierarchy, who is responsible for entering invoices and ensuring their accuracy, uniqueness, and completeness?
questions.explain: The Accounts Payable Specialist role is focused on entering invoices accurately and completely; supervisory roles sit above it in the hierarchy.

questions.q: What is typically true of the relationship between a manager job role (such as Accounts Payable Manager) and the specialist role beneath it?
options: The manager role has a completely separate, unrelated set of duty roles
There is no relationship between manager and specialist roles
The manager role usually inherits the specialist's duty roles plus additional ones, such as policy or approval-limit configuration
The manager role has strictly fewer duty roles than the specialist
questions.explain: Consistent with duty role inheritance from Lesson 4, a manager job role typically includes everything the specialist role includes, plus additional duty roles for oversight and policy tasks.

questions.q: At Castellan Robotics, where did the implementation team focus most of its actual configuration effort for the Payables job roles?
options: Deciding which business units each person's role assignment would cover, using the seeded roles mostly as delivered
Rebuilding the Accounts Payable Specialist role's duty roles from scratch
Removing all data security policies from every role
Renaming every seeded job role to match internal job titles
questions.explain: Most implementations use Oracle's seeded job roles largely as-is and focus configuration effort on data access (such as business unit assignment) rather than redesigning function access.

questions.q: Which Receivables job role manages and implements day-to-day customer payment activities, including receipts and collections support?
questions.explain: The Accounts Receivable Specialist role handles the hands-on, day-to-day customer payment activities, while the Manager role handles policy, process design, and reporting.
